summary: In Kiket Island, Swinomish Reservation, Washington, Swinomish Kiket Island Clam Garden is a monitoring and adaptive management initiative. The program uses community-based biocultural clam-garden restoration using rock-terrace construction and tending. The project responds to sea-level rise and ocean acidification. Available materials report that construction began and long-term monitoring initiated. The available materials do not identify a measured project outcome. The case is presented as an implementation example, not as evidence that the same results will occur in another place or under different conditions.
